title: 업체별 품목 단가관리 최근 거래업체 선택

criteria.customerUniverse: preserve existing active Customer with nonblank Manager; explicit search uses full universe
criteria.recent: KST today and preceding 89 calendar dates inclusive (90 days); exclude tomorrow/future
criteria.source: positive active OrderDetail via active OrderMaster.OrderDtm, OR positive ShipmentDetail.ShipmentDtm via active ShipmentMaster; no ShipmentDetail.isDeleted column assumed
criteria.join: OrderMasterKey and ShipmentKey PK joins; never OrderWeek-only joins; rolling window may cross years without conflating masters
criteria.search: trimmed nonempty customer-name or manager search bypasses recent filter; whitespace is default recent view
criteria.productRecent: products carry HasRecentTrade/LastTradeDtm from global positive active OrderDetail via OrderMaster.OrderDtm OR positive ShipmentDetail.ShipmentDtm via active ShipmentMaster, using the same KST 90-day window and PK joins; nonrecent products remain loaded for explicit picker search
criteria.productSelection: initial product selection is recent products only when product search is blank; explicit trimmed product search selects returned matches; picker blank shows recent products, picker search exposes all loaded products, and selected historical products remain matrix-visible after picker search clears
criteria.selection: customer filtering preserves selectedKeys; select-all toggles visible customers only, preserving hidden selections; blank product query initially selects recent products, explicit product search selects returned matches, picker filtering preserves selected hidden products, and bulk targets only selected currently visible products
criteria.sort: recent trade date descending then customer name/key
criteria.save: existing CustomerProdCost reads, PUT saveMatrix and EXE parity path unchanged

crossYearFixture.description: Recent rolling dates may span December/January using actual transaction dates and master PKs, never same OrderWeek collision. Old prior-year records remain excluded unless searched.
